grammar.title: Present perfect untuk update pekerjaan
grammar.explanation: Pakai present perfect (have/has + V3) untuk menyampaikan hasil yang relevan sekarang, tanpa menyebut waktu spesifik. Kalau waktunya disebut (yesterday, last week), pakai past simple.
examples: We haven't received the data yet.

grammar.title: Waiting for, not waiting
grammar.explanation: Kata kerja 'wait' butuh preposisi 'for' sebelum objek. Kesalahan ini sering muncul karena dalam bahasa Indonesia kita bilang 'menunggu data' tanpa kata depan.
examples: I'm waiting for the data from finance.

reading.title: Why remote teams write more
reading.text: Remote teams rely on written updates more than office teams do. When people work in different cities, or even different time zones, they can't just walk over to a colleague's desk. A clear written message often saves a follow-up meeting. Good updates answer three questions: what have I done, what am I working on now, and what is blocking me? A shared deadline and a short daily update keep everyone on track. The downside is that writing takes time, and long messages are easy to ignore. The best remote workers keep their updates short, specific, and easy to scan.

questions.q: Why do remote teams write more?
options: They can't easily talk face to face

questions.q: Which question does a good update NOT need to answer?
options: How many hours did I work?

questions.q: What is one downside of written updates?
options: Nobody reads them in the morning

writing.prompt: Tulis email singkat ke atasanmu, Sarah. Minta tenggat laporan diundur 2 hari karena data dari bagian keuangan belum masuk. Tawarkan satu solusi.
checklist: Permintaan memakai bentuk sopan (Could I / Would it be possible)
Ada tawaran solusi atau langkah berikutnya
useful_phrases: Please let me know if that works for you.
writing.model_answer:
Hi Sarah,

I'm writing about the client report due on Wednesday. I'm still waiting for the sales numbers from finance, so I won't be able to finish it on time. Would it be possible to move the deadline to Friday?

In the meantime, I can send you the first draft today so you can check the structure. I'll follow up with finance this afternoon.

Please let me know if that works for you.

Best,
Bagus

speaking.prompt: Ceritakan dalam 3 sampai 4 kalimat: apa yang sudah kamu kerjakan minggu ini, dan apa yang sedang menghambat.
speaking.sample_answer: This week I've finished the login page and fixed two bugs. I'm now working on the payment feature. The only thing blocking me is that I'm still waiting for the API keys from the client.

n1.them: Morning! Let's start. What did you work on yesterday?
hints: pakai I worked on / I finished

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Yesterday I finished the login page and fixed a bug in the search."

n2.them: Nice. And what are you working on today?
hints: pakai I'm working on / I'm going to

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Today I'm working on the payment feature."

hints: tidak ada: Nothing at the moment

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "I'm still waiting for the API keys from the client." atau "Nothing at the moment."

n4a.them: Okay, I'll follow up on that after the meeting. Can you still meet Friday's deadline?
hints: jawab yes/probably, beri syarat jika perlu

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Yes, as long as I get the keys by Wednesday."

n4b.them: Great. Do you have time to help Tom with the report this afternoon?
hints: setuju, atau tolak dengan sopan dan beri alasan

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "Sure, I can help after lunch." atau "I'm afraid my workload is heavy today. Could I help tomorrow?"

end.them: Thanks, everyone. Let's catch up again tomorrow.
